description: Put an activity on HubSpot records (one or more of contact_id, company_id, deal_id): kind "note" (default), "task" (follow-up with due_date YYYY-MM-DD, priority LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH), "call" (logged call) or "email" (logged e-mail, direction INCOMING_EMAIL|EMAIL). It appears in the record timeline. Nothing is sent to anyone. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run when write_mode is "dry_run" or dry_run is set.

dry_run.description: Only simulate and report what would happen; change nothing

name: add_hubspot_activity
